instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Merve told Jenny, “I will go inline skating after school.”
atoms.b: Merve told Jenny that she ((would_go)) inline skating after school.

atoms.a: Sam told Jonathan, “I am going to join the drama club.”
atoms.b: Sam told Jonathan that he ((was_going_to_join)) the drama club.
Lesley said that everyone ((had_to_protect)) the environment.

atoms.a: Nesli said, “I may bring my pet to school on Tuesday.”
atoms.b: Nesli said that she ((might_bring)) her pet to school on Tuesday.

example.a:
